notes.title: Eternal Edge + Release Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32748159/73128d342077c33856136e3cc06a00aba1bbcce6.png

Eternal Edge Plus Releasing Soon!

Hi everyone! We're excited to announce that we will be releasing Eternal Edge soon, we're still working on an exact date but were aiming for some time end of this month! The devs have been working hard at improving combat, content, visual improvements, optimizations, bug fixing and more.

The game has come a long way from launch and we're excited to show you how it's been progressing. Today we released a new trailer highlighting updates the game has had so far along with a new introduction to the game.

Check out the updates!

Eternal Edge + Game Trailer

https://youtu.be/GWss0TqwRnI

New Game Intro
https://youtu.be/6F8HwI_Uq9o

If you haven't already join us on Discord and wishlist the game:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/896440/Eternal_Edge/

notes.title: New Release Date: February 28th
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36467843/1e758c57e79a9cdb3b457a95d18d7cdd420e2fd8.jpg

Hi everyone! 

We recently pushed the release date to February 28th, this will give us time to help boost marketing the game and adding game updates.

We'll be working on releasing an update which includes an option to censor nudity in the game. Although the nudity is brief, this will help censor the content if you'd like to do that :)

We appreciate everyone's patience and very excited to release the game!

Have questions? Let us know in the Discussions!
